summary: Run allocation is exhausted and no new evidence is available; the draft bytes are the last accepted update, so this creates no duplicate revision. The investigation closed with a complete record: one asserted defect (shouldSnapshot's unsigned comparison of the log store's last index against the cached snapshot index makes a node whose store sits below its snapshot index report that it should snapshot and make redundant snapshot attempts at an unchanged index), witnessed over two real producers (CheckRun 9cba2e79ff6c4019b0f0381690d9aaab after a TrailingLogs=0 user snapshot; CheckRun e5116cfe896549deb27799d6d871ed77 after a follower installed a snapshot above its own log) and measured as wasted snapshot work with no safety effect (CheckRun a4a0cbfa094b4d1982032d9de0652861); three suspicions refuted with retained operands (voter-only commit eligibility, durable last vote across restart, AddVoter configuration lag as a bounded transient); and four durable Behaviors/Facts, two corrected under their own ids when measurement showed the per-interval implication and stored-count proxy were unsupported. Open unknowns remain recorded as limitations rather than assumptions.
